We had a very good experience during our two-night stay, even though the hotel was fully booked (last weekend before the school holidays). Everything was clean and well-organized despite the crowds. The buffet was amazing, with a wide variety of Javanese and Indonesian dishes. The location is excellent: right next to the Botanical Gardens and two shopping malls. A pleasant surprise in Indonesia: people walk, jog, and cycle around the Botanical Gardens in the evening. The hotel has a pool and a small fitness room. The staff was wonderful and very helpful. We had an issue with a room that smelled of smoke, but they quickly moved us and took care of everything. I think Europeans are more used to smoke-free spaces. I hope this becomes more common in Indonesia too.

On Saturday, I planned a holiday in Bogor and decided to stay at Hotel Santika because of its strategic location (in front of Tugu Kujang and in the same area with Botani Square Mall). I arrived at 11 A.M which is before check-in period and intended to park the car in hotel parking area while I go around mall first. I asked first to security guard at the hotel lobby and he directed me to parking space next to the mall and when I was already there, another security rejected me and tell me to search for regular parking spot along with other mall visitor (yes, the mall is really crowded on weekend) because the space is full. Isn't it one parking spot for one guest is one of hotel facility? And even if for level of Hotel Santika, it is really disappointing. After finally I got my room, I felt the wall is so this so I can hear my neighbour turn on the shower, the air conditioner make a weird sound, and the bed cover is quite smelly. Besides, I requested for hair dryer and I run out of it (I got it on the next morning after I reminded housekeeping staff once again). Still I relieved with nice breakfast menu that offers variation of Bogor traditional cuisines and cake. But if I ever asked, does my stay is worth the money? No. Do I want to stay here again? No, thank you.

judul_ulasan: A good value hotel in a great location
teks_ulasan: Overall our stay at this hotel was great. Good hotel condition and cleanliness, great breakfast, very friendly staff and great view of the mountains. Connected to the mall and easy access to the tollway, very convenient. Overall great value. Our only setback was getting to the lobby in our car. We were treated like other mall visitors. We arrived around the mall's peak hours on a weekend. The main entrance was closed with security guards screening which cars can enter (we didn't get through despite our claim of checking in to the hotel), we had to use the side entrance. We didn't know where the lobby was, that's why we complied (the security guy only told us that the hotel was also accessible via the side entrance). We had to queue with other cars looking for parking space at the mall. It turned out that the lobby was only about 50 meters from the main entrance with no traffic. It could have taken us less than a minute to get to the lobby if they had let us use the main entrance, instead it took us 30 minutes

部屋に冷蔵庫がなかったこととセイフテイボックスが固定されておらず、持ち出されたら意味がないのではないか？プ－ルに脱衣室がない。接客は丁寧でよかった。

judul_ulasan: 立地いいが、普通のビジネスホテル
teks_ulasan: 立地は高速出口すぐで、モールと直結、植物園にも近い。 但し植物園に歩いていくと、10～15分ほどだが途中非常に道が汚い。 新しいホテルでロビーも部屋も綺麗。 部屋はSuperiorだったが、冷蔵庫なし。バスタブなし。プールは小さくあえて入ろうという気にはならない。朝食ビュッフェはこの値段のホテルにしては充実。 たまたたまとまった部屋が、冷房の設備か何かに近く、数分おきにゴトンと音がなるのが気になってしょうがなく安眠できず。高速出口向きの部屋だったが、アザーンがかなりうるさく、これまた安眠できず。 総合的に、普通のビジネスホテルという感じで、また泊まりたいとは思わないが、ここしかないと言われれば別に不満はない、という感じです。

Santai sekejap di Bogor sebelun penerbangan pulang ke Malaysia, Santika hotel Bogor adalah hotel yang mudah lokasinya. Sarapan pagi yang pelbagai dengan citarasa masakan tradisi Indonesia dan American breakfast. Kakitangan F&B yang peramah dan layanan yang sangat mesra. Bilik hotel yang bersih dan selamat. Berhampiran dengan pusat beli belah moden Botani Square Bogor. Factory outlet yang berderetan di Jalan Padjajaran Bogor, hanya beberapa ratus meter dari hotel. Berdekatan dengan Station pengangkutan bas DAMRI ke Jakarta, Bandung dan CGK Airport, sangat mudah. Pasti menjadi pilihan saya apabila bertandang ke Bogor lagi.
這家飯店的性價比極高，地理位置優越，步行即可輕鬆造訪隔街的茂物植物園。生活機能也十分便利，飯店透過地下通道與旁邊的Botani Square Mall Bogor連通，無論購物或用餐都非常方便。整體價格相當實惠，是值得推薦的住宿選擇。

Semoga pandemi ini segera berakhir, aamiin.

Secara keseluruhan "baik" pelayannya. Sukses Santika Bogor. Terima kasih
